$comment: The plane's AI Gateways (workspace decisions 0021 (f) and (h), 0037; docs/architecture/plane.md, Inference seam). Two gateways by data class, both unable to store: logs off (collect_logs), cache off (cache_ttl 0), no Logpush, no OpenTelemetry exporter. The strict one carries typed text after the phone's PII gate and blocks personal data with DLP; the documents one carries the whole-CV parse the user opted into, where the CV's own name and phone must pass, so it has no DLP (and DLP does not read images anyway). `authentication` stays off: the Workers AI binding cannot send a gateway authorization header. `dlp_profile_names` are Cloudflare One DLP profiles by name; scripts/ai-gateway/apply.mjs resolves them to ids. scripts/ai-gateway/verify.mjs fails on any setting that could store.

dlp_profile_names: Social Security, Insurance, Tax, and Identifier Numbers
